What is the correct order of the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology steps?
Identify the problem; establish a theory; test the theory; establish a plan; implement or escalate; verify and prevent; document
Implement; identify; test; document; verify; plan; theorize
Document; identify; implement; verify; test; plan; escalate
Identify; implement; document; test; verify; plan; theorize
A user reports slow email. Which step comes FIRST?
Identify the problem by gathering information
After identifying a problem, what is the next step?
Establish a theory of probable cause
A technician forms a theory that DNS is failing. What should they do next?
Test the theory to determine the cause
A theory is confirmed by testing. What is the next step?
Establish a plan of action and identify potential effects
If testing does NOT confirm the theory, what should the technician do?
Establish a new theory or escalate
After establishing a plan, what is the next step?
Implement the solution or escalate as necessary
After implementing a solution, what should the technician do?
Verify full system functionality and implement preventive measures
What is the LAST step after verifying functionality?
Document findings, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned
Which step includes asking the user what changed recently?
Which step involves questioning the obvious and considering the OSI layers?
Establish a theory of probable cause
Which step involves making controlled, reversible changes to confirm a cause?
Test the theory to determine the cause
Which step includes creating a rollback plan?
Establish a plan of action and identify potential effects
Which step includes escalating when the issue is beyond your scope?
Implement the solution or escalate as necessary
Which step includes confirming the user can perform their task again?
Which step includes implementing measures to prevent recurrence?
Verify functionality and implement preventive measures
Which step produces a record for future reference?
Document findings, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned
A host has a 169.254.x.x address. In which step would you recognize this symptom?
A technician determines the cause is a duplex mismatch after checking error counters. Which step is this?
Test the theory to determine the cause
A technician schedules a maintenance window before changing a core switch. Which step is this?
A technician applies the planned configuration change. Which step is this?
A technician confirms performance matches the baseline after a fix. Which step is this?
A technician writes up the root cause and resolution in the ticket. Which step is this?
Why is it important to follow the methodology in order?
It leads to efficient, accurate resolution and avoids missed steps
A technician jumps straight to replacing hardware without identifying the problem. What is the risk?
Wasting effort and possibly not fixing the real issue
Which step would include consulting network documentation to form ideas about the cause?
Establish a theory of probable cause
Which step would a technician return to if a fix doesn't resolve the issue?
Establish a new theory of probable cause
A technician tests from multiple devices to determine scope. Which step is this?
Which step includes identifying potential effects of a change?
Establish a plan of action and identify potential effects
Which step is BEST associated with change management approval?
Establish a plan of action (and gain approval before implementing)
A technician escalates a suspected ISP outage with full details. Which step is this?
Implement the solution or escalate as necessary
Which step ensures no new problems were introduced by the fix?
Which step captures lessons learned for future incidents?
Document findings, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned
A user reports an issue that only happens in the afternoon. In which step is this timing captured?
Which step involves selecting the least disruptive test first?
Test the theory to determine the cause
A technician backs up the configuration before a change. Which step does this belong to?
Establish a plan of action (preparation) or implementation
Which step confirms the original symptom is gone?
Which step would include updating network diagrams that changed?
A technician considers both physical and logical causes for no connectivity. Which step is this?
Establish a theory of probable cause
Which step is primarily about preventing the problem from happening again?
Verify functionality and implement preventive measures
A technician changes one variable at a time while confirming a cause. Which step is this?
Test the theory to determine the cause
Which step would include notifying users of planned downtime?
Which step would a technician skip documentation at their peril?
A technician realizes the fix needs specialized skills during implementation. What should they do?
Escalate as part of the implement-or-escalate step
Which two steps bracket the actual implementation of a fix?
Establish a plan (before) and verify functionality (after)
Which step ensures the solution addressed the root cause, not just the symptom?
Verify functionality and implement preventive measures
A technician gathers error messages and logs. Which step is this?
Which methodology principle helps avoid introducing new issues?
Making controlled, reversible changes and verifying results
Why does documentation come after verification?
So the record reflects the confirmed resolution and outcomes
Which BEST summarizes the troubleshooting methodology?
A structured, ordered process from identifying the problem through documenting the resolution, with testing, planning, and verification along the way
